completion: Choose 2 or more test fields (columns) to work with. 3. Extract the data into a separate worksheet. 4. Calculate the mean (mean =average()). 5. Subtract the mean from mean+2 standard deviations (mean+2\textit{standard deviations }-mean=(c5)/=mean)=d6-cell range). 8. Copy and paste the result to a new worksheet. 9. Repeat #6 and #7. 10. Copy and paste all the results to the original data. 11. Keep the results to check if the result is a number > 0 (IF =if()). 12. Return the original
